_about: The only statements a brief may make about iTmethods products. Each claim's text is one sentence quoted exactly from the cited page as fetched live at the 'retrieved' time. Claims whose earlier wording is not on the current pages (Forge positioning, independent sale, the Executive Assurance Briefing funnel, 'works as first line') were removed after the independent fact-check (docs/qa/factcheck-report.md). claims.text: Reign Gateway gives applications and agents a governed path to approved models and tools.
Reign Assurance is in co-design development.
iTmethods does not issue an audit opinion or a certification, and nothing here is independent assurance of anyone’s controls.
Reign prepares the evidence; the people who own the risk decide.
The assurance and reliance judgments stay with your business, risk, compliance and audit experts, and any audit opinion or certification stays with their auditors.

iTmethods does not validate its own work, independently review it or subject it to effective challenge, and does not certify, attest, issue an audit opinion or provide independent assurance, so where any of those functions is required, we would work with a firm that holds that mandate.
Reign Ops and Reign Gateway are available today.
iTmethods is not FedRAMP authorized or CMMC certified, does not handle controlled unclassified information and does not claim ITAR compliance, so we confirm the supplier path before scoping begins.
